title: Matrix Product Operators In The Age of Block Encoding
summary: We develop a block-encoding compiler that treats matrix product operators as compressed, virtual-path linear combination of unitaries programs. The compiler constructs conditional PREP and local SELECT stages directly from a parent matrix product operator, establishing tensor networks as structured quantum intermediate representations that can be efficiently compiled to block-encoded circuits. We apply the construction to real-time evolution in the Heisenberg chain and two perturbed Heisenberg-family models.
